title.zh: 整形外科與燒傷值班日
title.en: A shift in plastic surgery and burns

tagline.zh: 從一顆小痣到一鍋熱湯
tagline.en: From a small mole to a pot of soup

desc.zh: 第一台刀的助手、燒傷評估的第一線。你寫手術紀錄、畫燒傷圖、打電話。
desc.en: First assistant for the morning case and first on the scene for every burn. You write the op note, draw the burn chart and make the calls.

desc.zh: 燒傷中心的靈魂。你負責冷卻、保暖、敷料、尿量，還有讓病人安心。
desc.en: The soul of the burn centre. Cooling, warming, dressings, urine output, and keeping the patient calm are yours.

about.zh: 說話慢、問題多。辦公桌上那杯咖啡從沒喝完過。
about.en: Speaks slowly, asks a lot. The coffee on her desk is never finished.

about.zh: 氣道的守門人。對燒傷病人的氣道特別敏感，一聽到「聲音沙啞」就站起來。
about.en: Guardian of the airway. Stands up the moment anyone says 'hoarse voice'.

about.zh: 手術室裡走最多步的人。記得每一件器械的名字和每一個人的生日。
about.en: Walks the most steps of anyone in theatre. Knows every instrument and everyone's birthday.

about.zh: 七十二歲，退休裁縫，合唱團男低音。臉頰上的小痣這半年變大、會流血。他最擔心的是疤。
about.en: Seventy-two, retired tailor, bass in the church choir. A small mole on his cheek has grown and bled for six months. His main worry is the scar.

about.zh: 五十八歲麵攤老闆，一鍋大骨湯翻了。胸口和右手臂起水泡，還在想中午誰顧攤。
about.en: Fifty-eight, runs a noodle stall. A pot of bone broth tipped over his chest and right arm. He is still wondering who will mind the stall at lunch.

about.zh: 十九歲學徒，油鍋起火時衝回去關瓦斯。鼻毛燒焦、聲音沙啞、咳出黑痰。
about.en: Nineteen, kitchen apprentice. Ran back to turn off the gas when the oil caught fire. Singed nasal hair, hoarse voice, black sputum.

about.zh: 急診的總機兼守門員。講話快，用 ISBAR 交班從不漏項。
about.en: The emergency department's switchboard and goalkeeper. Talks fast; never skips an ISBAR item.

about.zh: 夜班的眼睛。每小時量一次尿量，數字不對就打電話，從不猶豫。
about.en: The night shift's eyes. Measures urine output every hour and phones the moment a number is wrong.

plain.zh: 皮膚上天然的張力方向。順著皮紋切，疤痕最不明顯。
plain.en: The natural lines of tension in the skin. Cutting along them gives the least visible scar.

plain.zh: 把病灶連同一圈安全邊緣切成兩頭尖的橄欖形，縫起來才平整。
plain.en: Removing a lesion with a margin of normal skin in a lens shape, so the wound closes flat.

plain.zh: 劃刀前全隊停下來，核對病人、部位、手術名稱和過敏。
plain.en: Before the incision the whole team stops to confirm patient, site, operation and allergies.

plain.zh: 手術前後把每一件器械、紗布、縫針數清楚，確保沒有留在病人體內。
plain.en: Counting every instrument, swab and needle before and after surgery so nothing is left behind.

plain.zh: 把身體分成幾個約百分之九的區塊，快速估算燒傷面積。
plain.en: Dividing the body into regions of roughly nine percent each to estimate burn size quickly.

plain.zh: 燒到真皮層。會起水泡、底部粉紅、很痛，多半能自己長回來。
plain.en: A burn into the dermis: blisters, a pink base, very painful, usually heals by itself.

plain.zh: 整層皮膚都燒壞了。看起來蠟白或焦黑、不痛、不會自己癒合。
plain.en: The whole skin is destroyed: waxy white or charred, painless, will not heal on its own.

plain.zh: 一張人形圖，把燒傷的位置和深度塗上去，算面積、記錄變化。
plain.en: A body outline on which the burned areas and depths are shaded to calculate size and track change.

plain.zh: 每小時排出多少尿。燒傷輸液夠不夠，就看這個最可靠。
plain.en: How much urine is passed each hour: the most reliable guide to whether burn fluids are enough.

plain.zh: 吸進熱氣、煙和有毒氣體，傷到氣道和肺。可能幾小時後才腫起來。
plain.en: Damage to the airway and lungs from hot gas, smoke and toxic fumes. Swelling may appear hours later.

plain.zh: 打電話交班的順序：我是誰、情況、背景、評估、建議。
plain.en: The order for a handover call: identify, situation, background, assessment, recommendation.

plain.zh: 傷口感染一種細菌造成的嚴重肌肉痙攣。燒傷要確認疫苗狀態。
plain.en: Severe muscle spasms from a bacterium that infects wounds. Every burn needs the vaccination status checked.

plain.zh: 環狀全層燒傷會像束帶一樣勒住肢體或胸廓，必要時切開硬痂減壓。
plain.en: A circumferential full-thickness burn can tighten like a band; cutting the hard eschar releases it.

text.zh: 用電流止血或切割組織。臉部精細手術用低功率、細尖頭。
text.en: Uses electric current to seal bleeding or cut tissue. Fine facial work uses a low setting and a needle tip.

text.zh: 燒傷病人失去皮膚保溫，會很快失溫。冷卻傷口、保暖病人，兩件事同時做。
text.en: Burned skin cannot hold heat, so patients cool quickly. Cool the wound, warm the patient: both at once.

text.zh: 夾在手指上量血氧。一氧化碳中毒時數字會騙人，看起來正常其實缺氧。
text.en: Clips on a finger to read oxygen saturation. With carbon monoxide poisoning it lies and reads normal.

text.zh: 切下來的病灶泡在固定液裡送病理。方向要標記，病理科才知道哪一邊邊緣不夠。
text.en: The excised lesion goes to pathology in fixative. Mark its orientation so pathology can say which margin is close.

text.zh: 你親手畫的那張。胸前和右上臂塗成部分層，面積寫在角落。
text.en: The one you drew yourself: chest and right upper arm shaded partial-thickness, the total in the corner.

text.zh: 頭頸九、每隻手臂九、每隻腿十八、軀幹前後各十八。只算部分層以上，一度不算。
text.en: Head and neck nine, each arm nine, each leg eighteen, front and back of trunk eighteen each. Count only partial thickness or deeper.

text.zh: 電話旁那張小卡。每一通轉診電話照著唸，對方就不會漏聽。
text.en: The small card by the phone. Read every referral call off it and nothing gets missed.

lines.zh: 手術室的燈剛亮。白板上寫著今天的刀表，旁邊貼著一張 ISBAR 卡。
lines.en: The theatre lights have just come on. Today's list is on the whiteboard, an ISBAR card taped beside it.

lines.zh: 早。第一台是陳伯伯，左臉頰病灶切除，局部麻醉加鎮靜。
lines.en: Morning. First case is Mr Chen, left cheek lesion excision under local with sedation.

lines.zh: 燒傷病房五床昨晚尿量在邊緣，夜班有調整過了。阿美說她會盯。
lines.en: Burn ward bed five had borderline urine output overnight; the night team adjusted. Mei says she is watching it.

lines.zh: 收到。五床我等一下去看。
lines.en: Got it. I will look in on bed five later.

lines.zh: 早。咖啡幫我放桌上，我大概又喝不到。
lines.en: Morning. Leave the coffee on my desk; I probably will not get to it again.

lines.zh: 陳伯伯的病灶在臉頰。你會怎麼決定切口的方向？
lines.en: Mr Chen's lesion is on the cheek. How would you decide the direction of the incision?

lines.zh: 順著皮紋，做梭形切除，長軸跟張力線平行。
lines.en: Along the skin tension lines: a fusiform excision with its long axis parallel to them.

lines.zh: 好。那病理科要知道什麼？
lines.en: Good. And what does pathology need to know?

lines.zh: 檢體的方向，還有臨床懷疑什麼。
lines.en: Which way the specimen is oriented, and what we suspect clinically.

lines.zh: 記住這兩句，下午會用到。
lines.en: Remember both of those. You will need them this afternoon.

guide.en: Meet Mr Chen at the door

lines.zh: 醫師，我下個月有演出。這個疤會不會很明顯？
lines.en: Doctor, I have a concert next month. Will the scar be very obvious?

lines.zh: 我們會順著您臉上自然的紋路切，疤會藏在裡面。先確認一下，是左臉這一顆對嗎？
lines.en: We will cut along the natural lines of your face so the scar hides in them. Let me confirm: it is this one on the left cheek?

lines.zh: 對，就是這顆。會流血的那顆。
lines.en: Yes, that one. The one that bleeds.

lines.zh: 你在病灶旁用記號筆做了部位標記，請他再看一次同意書。
lines.en: You mark the site beside the lesion with the skin marker and ask him to read the consent form once more.

lines.zh: 臉部細器械一套、電燒細尖頭、縫線都在。保溫毯你要先開嗎？
lines.en: Fine facial set, needle-tip diathermy, sutures all here. Do you want the warming blanket on already?

lines.zh: 先開。局部麻醉的病人躺久也會冷。
lines.en: Yes. Patients get cold lying still even under local.

note.zh: 陳伯伯的病灶切除完成

guide.zh: 刷完手，到手術台設計切口

lines.zh: 刷手台的水溫剛好。你從指尖刷到手肘，心裡默數，走向手術台。
lines.en: The scrub-sink water is just right. You scrub from fingertips to elbows, counting, and walk to the table.

lines.zh: 陳伯伯鎮靜好了，還聽得到我們說話。講話小聲一點。
lines.en: Mr Chen is sedated but can still hear us. Keep your voices down.

lines.zh: 先畫再切。你來設計這個梭形，我看。
lines.en: Draw before you cut. You design the ellipse; I will watch.

post.zh: 長軸是短軸的三倍左右，兩端才不會皺起來。可以。
post.en: Long axis about three times the short one, so the ends do not pucker. That will do.

lines.zh: 各位，時間暫停。
lines.en: Everyone, time-out.

lines.zh: 陳伯伯，左臉頰病灶梭形切除，部位已標記，無已知過敏。
lines.en: Mr Chen, fusiform excision of a left cheek lesion, site marked, no known allergies.

lines.zh: 跟我一起數：紗布十、縫針三、刀片一。
lines.en: Count with me: swabs ten, needles three, blade one.

lines.zh: 紗布十、縫針三、刀片一。器械清點正確。
lines.en: Swabs ten, needles three, blade one. Instrument count correct.

guide.zh: 病灶切下來了：標記檢體

lines.zh: 切下來了。邊緣看起來乾淨。檢體你打算怎麼送？
lines.en: It is out. The margins look clean. How are you sending the specimen?

q.en: How should the specimen go to pathology?

options.zh: 縫一針標記十二點鐘方向，寫上臨床懷疑
options.en: Stitch to mark twelve o'clock, note the suspicion

why.zh: 有方向，病理科才能告訴你哪一邊邊緣不夠，需要補切。
why.en: With an orientation mark pathology can tell you which margin is close and needs re-excision.

why.zh: 沒有方向的檢體，如果邊緣不夠，你不知道要補哪一邊。
why.en: Without orientation you will not know which side to re-excise if a margin is involved.

options.zh: 放生理食鹽水裡等下午一起送
options.en: Keep it in saline until the afternoon batch

why.zh: 檢體要立刻進固定液，泡在食鹽水會影響判讀。
why.en: Specimens go into fixative at once; soaking in saline degrades them.

lines.zh: 臉上的縫線要細、要密、要平。來。
lines.en: Facial sutures: fine, close together, everted. Go.

post.zh: ……醫師，結束了嗎？我剛剛在心裡唱了兩首歌。
post.en: ...Doctor, is it over? I sang two songs in my head.

post.zh: 結束了，陳伯伯。下週回來拆線。
post.en: All done, Mr Chen. Back next week for the sutures.

sub.en: 10:30 · the phone and the theatre door

lines.zh: 整形外科嗎？我是急診林醫師。五十八歲男性，大骨湯翻倒，胸前和右臂燙傷。
lines.en: Plastics? Dr Lin, emergency. Fifty-eight-year-old man, bone broth tipped over his chest and right arm.

lines.zh: 有水泡，很痛，意識清楚，氣道沒問題。你要我們現在先做什麼？
lines.en: Blisters, very painful, fully alert, airway fine. What do you want us to do right now?

q.en: What do you ask the ER to do first?

options.zh: 流動冷水沖、移除衣物、保暖、送上來
options.en: Running water, remove clothing, keep warm, send up

why.zh: 流動的涼水降低組織溫度，同時脫掉吸了熱湯的衣服，並且幫病人保暖。
why.en: Cool running water lowers tissue temperature; the soaked clothes come off; and the patient stays warm.

why.zh: 冰會讓血管收縮，傷口變得更深，而且病人很快失溫。
why.en: Ice constricts vessels, deepens the wound, and the patient becomes hypothermic fast.

why.zh: 藥膏會蓋住傷口，我們上面就看不清深度，還得洗掉。
why.en: Ointment hides the wound; we cannot judge depth and have to wash it off again.

post.zh: 我是整形外科住院醫師，請直接送燒傷中心，我在門口等。
post.en: Plastics resident here. Send him straight to the burn centre; I will be at the door.

lines.zh: 醫師，我沒事啦，就是痛。中午誰顧攤啊……
lines.en: Doctor, I am fine, it just hurts. Who is going to mind the stall at lunch...

lines.zh: 攤子先放著，阿海。先清潔，再評估。
lines.en: The stall can wait, A-Hai. Clean first, then assess.

lines.zh: 機轉是熱湯，不是火。想想這對深度代表什麼。然後用九分法：胸前一片、右上臂一圈。
lines.en: The mechanism is soup, not flame; think what that means for depth. Then the rule of nines: a patch on the chest, a band round the right upper arm.

post.zh: 記得：一度不計入。只算起水泡以上的。
post.en: Remember: first degree does not count. Only blistered or deeper.

lines.zh: 急診用了冰。你看邊緣，比中央還蒼白，而且他在發抖。
lines.en: The ER used ice. Look at the edge: paler than the centre, and he is shivering.

lines.zh: 保溫毯，現在。冰敷讓邊緣變深了。
lines.en: Warming blanket, now. The ice has deepened the margin.

lines.zh: 水泡、底部粉紅、壓了會變白、很痛。
lines.en: Blisters, pink base, blanches on pressure, very painful.

question.zh: 這是哪一種深度的燒傷？
question.en: What depth of burn is this?

answer.zh: 淺層部分層燒傷。底部粉紅、會變白、感覺完整。深部分層會偏白、不太變白、感覺變鈍。
answer.en: A superficial partial-thickness burn. Pink base, blanches, sensation intact. Deep partial-thickness is paler, blanches poorly and feels dull.

post.zh: 四十八小時後再看一次。燒傷會「變深」，不是你看錯。
post.en: Look again at forty-eight hours. Burns 'convert' deeper; it is not that you misjudged.

lines.zh: 阿美交班的時候會問你順序。你來排。
lines.en: Mei will ask you the sequence at handover. You put it in order.

q.zh: 燒傷第一線處置的順序？
q.en: Order the first steps for a burn.

steps.zh: 停止燒灼、確保自身安全
steps.en: Stop the burning, keep yourself safe

lines.zh: 面積算出來了。那他需要公式輸液嗎？你自己判斷。
lines.en: You have the size. Does he need formula resuscitation? You decide.

lines.zh: 面積超過啟動門檻，而且是成人軀幹加上肢。我會啟動，起算時間從燙傷那一刻。
lines.en: The area is over the threshold, trunk plus a limb in an adult. I would start, timed from the moment of the scald.

lines.zh: 破傷風狀態問了嗎？止痛呢？
lines.en: Tetanus status asked? Analgesia?

lines.zh: 都依醫囑給了。破傷風十年內有打過。
lines.en: Both given per the orders. Tetanus within ten years.

lines.zh: 醫師，你們這裡的湯比較沒有味道。
lines.en: Doctor, the soup here has less flavour.

note.zh: 燒傷圖畫好、病理檢體送出

lines.zh: 病理科：「臉頰檢體沒有方向標記。若邊緣不足，將無法指出位置。」
lines.en: Pathology: 'Cheek specimen arrived without an orientation mark. If a margin is involved we cannot say which.'

lines.zh: 就是早上說的那兩句。下次縫一針，三十秒。
lines.en: Those two sentences from this morning. Next time one stitch, thirty seconds.

lines.zh: 記住了。
lines.en: Noted.

lines.zh: 病理科：「臉頰檢體已收到，方向標記清楚，謝謝。」
lines.en: Pathology: 'Cheek specimen received, orientation clearly marked, thank you.'

lines.zh: 你看，三十秒的一針，省掉一通電話。
lines.en: See: a thirty-second stitch saves a phone call.

lines.zh: 燒傷圖自己畫。塗的時候再想一次：哪裡是部分層、哪裡只是紅。
lines.en: Draw the burn chart yourself. As you shade, think again: which parts are partial thickness and which are just red.

lines.zh: 你把胸前和右上臂塗上斜線，在角落寫下面積和時間。
lines.en: You hatch the chest and right upper arm and write the total and the time in the corner.

lines.zh: 周主治，你的咖啡……我幫你換一杯熱的？
lines.en: Dr Chou, your coffee... shall I get you a hot one?

lines.zh: 放著，它有陪伴的功能。對了，阿海右上臂是整圈燒到嗎？
lines.en: Leave it; it is there for company. By the way, is A-Hai's right upper arm burned all the way round?

lines.zh: 差一點。內側有一條沒燒到。
lines.en: Almost. A strip on the inner side is spared.

lines.zh: 整圈的全層燒傷會像束帶。每小時摸遠端脈搏；整圈變硬，就是想焦痂切開的時候。
lines.en: A circumferential full-thickness burn acts like a band. Feel the distal pulse hourly; tight all round is when to think about escharotomy.

lines.zh: 又是我。阿海的學徒，十九歲，油鍋起火時衝回去關瓦斯。
lines.en: Me again. A-Hai's apprentice, nineteen, ran back to turn off the gas when the oil caught.

lines.zh: 臉有點紅，燒傷面積不大。但他聲音沙啞，鼻毛燒焦，咳黑痰。血氧儀顯示正常。
lines.en: Face a little red, small burn area. But hoarse voice, singed nasal hair, black sputum. Oximeter reads normal.

lines.zh: 血氧儀在這種情況會騙人。請直接送上來，我通知麻醉科。
lines.en: The oximeter can lie in this setting. Send him straight up; I will call anaesthesia.

lines.zh: 我沒燒到多少啦……只是喉嚨怪怪的。
lines.en: I am barely burned... my throat just feels weird.

lines.zh: 面積小，但你要看的不是面積。徵象辨識，一個一個來。
lines.en: Small area, but area is not what you are looking at. Recognise the signs, one by one.

lines.zh: 密閉空間、臉部燒傷、鼻毛燒焦、聲音沙啞、黑痰。吸入性損傷的徵象他幾乎全中。
lines.en: Enclosed space, facial burn, singed nasal hair, hoarse voice, black sputum. He has nearly every sign of inhalation injury.

lines.zh: 聲音沙啞加黑痰，我就不會等。
lines.en: Hoarse voice plus black sputum: I do not wait.

lines.zh: 阿凱說話越來越費力。吸氣時有一點高音。
lines.en: A-Kai's speech is getting more effortful. There is a faint high note on inspiration.

options.zh: 給氧、請麻醉科現在就來評估早期插管
options.en: Oxygen; anaesthesia to assess for early intubation now

why.zh: 吸入性損傷的氣道會在幾小時內腫起來，越晚插越難。
why.en: An inhalation-injured airway swells over hours; the later you intubate, the harder it gets.

options.zh: 先照胸部 X 光再說

why.zh: 早期的 X 光多半正常，等結果只會浪費氣道還能通過的時間。
why.en: Early films are usually normal; waiting wastes the time the airway is still passable.

options.en: Observe and tell him to talk less

why.zh: 聲音沙啞加喘鳴已經是警訊，不是觀察的時候。
why.en: Hoarseness plus stridor is already a warning, not something to watch.

lines.zh: 你來講：現在插，還是再等？理由。
lines.en: You tell me: intubate now, or wait? Reasons.

post.zh: 對。而且是由最有經驗的人來插，不是在走廊上插。
post.en: Right. And the most experienced person does it, not in a corridor.

post.zh: 阿凱！你這個笨蛋，瓦斯關不關有什麼關係！
post.en: A-Kai! You idiot, who cares about the gas!

guide.zh: 安置阿凱並通知加護病房

lines.zh: 管路固定好了，你用膠布之外再加一條綁帶——臉部燒傷的膠布會黏不住。
lines.en: The tube is secured; you add a tie as well as tape, because tape will not hold on burned skin.

lines.zh: 加護病房嗎？我用 ISBAR 交班：十九歲男性，吸入性損傷，已插管……
lines.en: ICU? Handing over by ISBAR: nineteen-year-old man, inhalation injury, intubated...

note.en: Day handed over to the night team

guide.en: Hand over to the night team

lines.zh: 夜班到了。你來講。
lines.en: The night team is here. Your handover.

lines.zh: 陳伯伯：左臉頰病灶切除，檢體已送，下週拆線。
lines.en: Mr Chen: left cheek lesion excised, specimen sent, sutures out next week.

lines.zh: 阿海：胸前與右上臂部分層燙傷，公式輸液中，每小時尿量，右臂每小時脈搏。
lines.en: A-Hai: partial-thickness scald to chest and right upper arm, on formula fluids, hourly urine output, hourly pulse in the right arm.

lines.zh: 阿凱：吸入性損傷，已插管，在加護病房。
lines.en: A-Kai: inhalation injury, intubated, in the ICU.

lines.zh: 陳伯伯的手術紀錄：切口方向、邊緣寬度、檢體方向、縫合方式。
lines.en: Mr Chen's op note: incision direction, margin width, specimen orientation, closure.

lines.zh: 阿海的輸液起算時間寫清楚：從燙傷的那一刻算，不是從到院。
lines.en: A-Hai's fluid start time written clearly: from the moment of the scald, not from arrival.

guide.en: Hand over dressings and output chart

lines.zh: 你把敷料更換時間、尿量表和保溫毯設定交給阿美。她點點頭，筆已經在動了。
lines.en: You hand Mei the dressing schedule, the output chart and the blanket settings. She nods; her pen is already moving.

lines.zh: 今天三個病人。哪一個最小，哪一個最危險？
lines.en: Three patients today. Which was the smallest, and which the most dangerous?

lines.zh: 阿凱的面積最小，也最危險。
lines.en: A-Kai had the smallest burn and was the most dangerous.

lines.zh: 對。面積是數字，氣道是時間。今天你兩個都看見了。
lines.en: Yes. Area is a number; the airway is time. Today you saw both.

lines.zh: 回家吧。那杯咖啡我帶回去當紀念。
lines.en: Go home. I am taking that coffee home as a souvenir.

sub.zh: 阿海的尿量連續兩小時偏低
sub.en: A-Hai's urine output low two hours running

lines.zh: 醫師，阿海的尿量連續兩小時低於目標。血壓還好，心跳偏快，他說口渴。
lines.en: Doctor, A-Hai's urine output has been below target for two hours. Pressure is fine, pulse a little fast, he says he is thirsty.

lines.zh: 謝謝你打來。我現在看。
lines.en: Thank you for calling. Looking now.

post.zh: 好，依醫囑調整，一小時後我再回報。
post.en: Right, adjusting per the orders. I will report back in an hour.

guide.en: Check the numbers an hour later

lines.zh: 一小時後，尿量回到目標範圍。阿海睡了，右手的脈搏清楚。
lines.en: An hour later the output is back in range. A-Hai is asleep; the pulse in his right hand is clear.

lines.zh: （訊息）阿美跟我說了。你沒有只加水，你有先摸脈搏、看腹部。很好。
lines.en: (message) Mei told me. You did not just add fluid; you felt the pulse and checked the abdomen first. Good.

lines.zh: （訊息）明天早上，咖啡我請。這次我會喝。
lines.en: (message) Coffee is on me tomorrow morning. This time I will drink it.

sub.zh: 一顆痣、兩個燒傷、一杯沒喝的咖啡
sub.en: One mole, two burns and a cup of coffee no one drank
